Read the full field layout (description_fields, properties_fields, step_fields with real system_field_id/custom_field_id values) of the workspace's default system template (1164), since get_template is documented as 'the only read that returns the field layout' and this is the only way to obtain real, non-invented field ids.

Identical 'Non-removable System fields not present in template' error. This rules out 'missing some field id' as the cause: the fields the create endpoint calls 'non-removable' are not among any of the ids get_template exposes for this template at all — they are either hidden entirely from this read surface (consistent with the separate documented behavior that Review & Approve fields are filtered out of reads) or identified by something other than the id/is_system pair the create contract accepts.

contract.json_path: none — flat top-level body: name, entity, description_fields, properties_fields, linked_projects. Confirmed by attempt 2: wrapping the payload under a "template" key is explicitly rejected ("unknown body: template").
declared_missing: Which system field id(s) are 'non-removable' and therefore mandatory in description_fields/properties_fields on create. The contract documents description_fields/properties_fields as fully optional ('Omitting this creates a template with an empty description section') and gives no list of mandatory system fields. Live preprod requires certain 'Non-removable System fields' or it 400s with templateFieldValidationError — and per attempt 6, these are not even among the full set of field ids exposed by get_template for an existing, valid template of the same entity type, so the documented read surface cannot resolve them either.

notes: No template was created in any of the 6 attempts — all were rejected before the API returned a 201, so there is no created template id to clean up, and the pre-existing system templates (1164, 1664) were only read via get_template/list_templates, never modified. Field-id discovery used capability='list_templates' (query {p:1,count:300}) to find template ids 1164 ('Test Case Steps', default, field_count 45) and 1664 ('Test Case BDD', field_count 47), then capability='get_template' (path_params {id:1164}) to read its real description_fields/properties_fields. Sent ids: description_fields=[1,2,3,4,8,9] (all is_system:true), properties_fields tried both as system-only [10,11,12,13,14,15,16] (attempt 4) and as the full system+custom mirror of all 37 entries on template 1164 (attempt 6) — both is_system:true/false set per whether the source entry carried system_field_id or custom_field_id. Neither satisfied the validator. Core finding, now with stronger evidence than the first pass: create_template's contract claims description_fields/properties_fields are optional, but live preprod 400s with templateFieldValidationError ('Non-removable System fields not present in template') whenever these arrays are present without whatever fields it considers non-removable — and that requirement cannot be resolved via the documented read surface (get_template), since reproducing the exact field census of a real, valid, system-default template of the same entity type still fails identically. This is consistent with the separately-documented note that update_template auto-injects 'Review & Approve' fields that get_template's read explicitly filters out even when a template stores them — i.e. the non-removable fields the create validator wants are plausibly these same filtered-out fields, which no read capability in this contract surface exposes an id for. Verdict stays BLOCKED: the capability is not invocable to a successful 201 using only ids obtainable from the documented capability surface, and this second pass strengthens rather than weakens that conclusion.
